title: fix(fields): password, secret, vector and grid cells draw "No value" when nothing is stored (objectui#8678)
body:
Fixes #8678
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`getCellRenderer`'s standard table registered `password`, `secret`, `vector` and `grid` as argument-less arrows that never read `value`. Every input, `null` included, drew the six-dot mask or the `[Vector]` / `[Grid]` literal. Those four entries now point at three named module-level renderers in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`. None of them is exported.

- `MaskedCellRenderer` (`password`, `secret`): the shared `EmptyValue` affordance (accessible name "No value") when nothing is stored. Otherwise the same mask span as before. The value is never printed.
- `VectorCellRenderer` / `GridCellRenderer`: the affordance when nothing is stored. Otherwise the same literal span as before.

They are named rather than inline because `EmptyValue` holds a hook. An inline arrow in the table is a new component type on every resolution, so it would tear that hook down on every render. That is the objectui#8441 reason, and the table's docblock now says it.

## Which inputs count as empty, per value class (read from the spec, not the card)

| type | value class, and where it is read from | empty, so it draws the affordance | stored, so it keeps today's face |
|---|---|---|---|
| `password`, `secret` | `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` in `@objectstack/spec` | `TextCellRenderer`'s own predicate, the floor on the coerced text: `null`, `undefined`, `''`, `[]`, and any array whose coerced text is `''` | `{}` (per the objectui#8596 string-class ruling), a whitespace-only string (`text` keeps its spaces, and a blank credential is still a set one), any other string |
| `vector` | `valueSchemaFor`: `z.array(z.number())` | the floor exactly: `null`, `undefined`, `''`, `[]` | `{}`, and every other value |
| `grid` | not a spec `FieldType`, so the class is `GridField`'s own contract: an array of row objects | the floor exactly | `{}`, and every other value |

**Why `{}` is not added for `vector` / `grid`:** neither class can produce it. The spec's write seam refuses a non-array `vector`, and that is pinned as a premise below. `GridField` writes arrays. Also, `hasCellValue` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` calls every object filled, so a `{}` clause would draw "No value" inside a row that band has already called filled.

**The platform contract this restores:** the `SECRET_MASK` docblock in `@objectstack/spec/data` (installed 17.4.0), verbatim: "An UNSET credential reads back `null` instead, never this mask — the masking is presence-preserving on both surfaces, which is what lets a console render "configured" vs "not configured" at all."

**objectui#8440 (the clipboard half), read before choosing:** it is closed (ruling A, landed), and this change leaves it as it was. Its gate reads `hasCellValue` plus the masked-type set in plugin-detail. An empty credential row was never copy-interactive, and a populated one still draws the mask. Its pin `DetailSection.maskedCopyRefusal-8440` passes on this branch.

## Measurement: objectui#8596's census instrument, taken again

Every registered type (`listCellRendererTypes()`, 53 at this base) was rendered through `getCellRenderer` against 15 inputs: `[]`, `{}`, `''`, `null`, `undefined`, a whitespace string, `{a:1}`, `[null]`, `['']`, `0`, `false`, a string, `[1,2,3]`, `[[1]]` and `SECRET_MASK`. The innerHTML was diffed between `bc4efba` (base) and `dd068fd` (the fix commit).

- **18 of 795 cells moved.** All 18 are in the four types, and all 18 moved onto the affordance: `[]`, `''`, `null` and `undefined` for each of the four, plus `['']` for `password` and `secret`.
- The other 49 types, every `{}` cell and every stored-value cell render byte-identical.

This is a single reading from a probe that was not committed. `cellRenderers.valueIndependent-8678` re-derives the four types' rows on every run.

## Existing pins this change made false, now updated

- `cellRenderers.signatureValueClass-8677`: its census required `password` / `secret` to draw the same face for `null` as for a value. That is exactly the defect. The excluded set is now `MASKED_FACES`, measured as one face for every stored value, `{}` included, with the value absent from the DOM and the affordance for nothing stored.
- `cellRenderers.countLabelI18n-8441`: a control proved that the resolver rebuilds its table by using `vector` as the last inline arrow. There is no inline entry left, so the control has nothing to test and is retired with a note. The property it protected is now pinned for every registered type by the new file's IDENTITY test.
- `cellRenderers.objectLiteral-8596`: census rows unchanged, because the `{}` column did not move. Only the section label changed ("value-independent" is no longer true).

## New pin: `packages/fields/src/__tests__/cellRenderers.valueIndependent-8678.test.tsx` (37 tests)

- PREMISE: class membership comes from the installed spec. `valueSchemaFor({type:'vector'})` accepts a real embedding (the lit half) and refuses `{}`. `grid` is absent from `FieldType.options`, with `vector` present as the control.
- CENSUS: the four types × `[]`, `{}`, `''`, `null`, `undefined`. Each case asserts the defect is absent before it asserts the replacement.
- RULE: `password` / `secret` render byte-equal to `text` for every input `text` calls empty, with a control showing that `text` really does separate the inputs.
- POPULATED: one real value per type, and the face must be byte-for-byte the pre-change span. This is the lit control, and it refuses "EmptyValue for everything". It also checks that the stored credential never reaches the DOM.
- BOUNDARY: a whitespace-only credential keeps the mask, and `{a:1}` keeps the literal.
- IDENTITY: every registered type resolves to one function object across two resolutions.

## Verification, all run at HEAD `0cf9eaf` (the final commit), exit code captured before any pipe

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/ --maxWorkers=2`: exit 0, `Test Files 195 passed | 1 skipped (196)`, `Tests 3255 passed | 7 skipped (3262)`.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/fields --concurrency=2`: exit 0, `Tasks: 12 successful, 12 total`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all four touched test files.
- Consumers named by the census (`inlineCredentialGate`, `DetailSection.maskedCopyRefusal-8440`, `summaryChip.badgeFitCensus-8464`, console `SettingsView.crypto-unavailable`): exit 0, `Tests 111 passed (111)`.
- eslint on the changed files, plain form: exit 0, 0 errors, 156 warnings, and 0 of those on an added line (the rest are pre-existing `react-refresh` warnings in `index.tsx`). Narrowed, with the evidence for the narrowing:
  - The population comes from `eslint.config.js`: the five changed `.tsx` files. `.md` / `.mdx` get "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied."
  - The `--format json` count is 5 files.
  - Invariance: no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads another file. So this diff cannot move the verdict for any untouched file.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` · `check:test-path-roots` · `check:vi-mock-specifiers` · `check:vi-mock-inherit` · `check:vi-mock-override-shape` · `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`) · `check:changeset-claims` · `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0.
  - `check:changeset-claims` lists five pending changesets that name `index.tsx` / `grid.mdx`. Each paragraph was read (6357, 6625, 6694, 6837, 7166), and none concerns the four entries or the grid cell section.
- Gates derived from the workflows that read `.changeset/**` and `content/docs/**`: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-doc-component-types`, `check-prompt-component-keys`, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-shell-escape-residue`: all exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED:
  - `check-doc-snippet-types`: needs a filtered build. The docs edits are prose only, with no snippet added or changed. Declared to CI.
  - `check-readme-exports`: exit 1 with "type entry `./dist/index.d.ts` is not on disk -- run `pnpm build` first". The prerequisite is not met, so this is not a red result. No README or export moved.

## Ablation (one-time; not a permanent test)

Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` from the objectstack checkout. The anchor had to hit exactly once, the blob changed, and the restore was proven: blob equals HEAD `0b5e83a8bbfd` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The subject resolves from source (`../index`), and no `dist/` is on the path, so there is no build leg.

- **Leg A**, `password` / `secret` entries back to the base arrows: 11 of 37 red. That is 8 CENSUS empty rows, 2 RULE and IDENTITY, which names `password` and `secret`.
- **Leg B**, `vector` / `grid` back to the base arrows: 9 of 37 red. That is 8 CENSUS rows and IDENTITY, which names `grid` and `vector`.
- **Leg C**, the caricature (the masked stored branch returns the affordance): 10 of 37 red, covering every stored-value case of the masked types.

All three turned red, which is the expected direction.

## Acceptance notes

- **Surface.** The claim declared the four `standardMap` entries, pins beside the census tests, and one changeset. This PR also touches the following, each forced by the change:
  - The three renderer functions above the table, plus two docblocks in the same file: the table's own docblock and the emptiness-floor roster. Both would otherwise state something false.
  - Three existing pins in `packages/fields/src/__tests__/` (8441, 8596, 8677), which went red or became false.
  - Three docs pages: `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx`, `vector.mdx` and `password.mdx` (a new "Cell Renderer" section), under AGENTS.md #2.
  - No open PR lists any of these files; this was checked against every open PR's file list.
- **Drift left untouched (plugin-detail, outside this package):**
  - The `MASKED_CELL_FIELD_TYPES` docblock in `plugin-detail/src/fieldEnrichment.ts` quotes the retired arrow. Its argument still holds: `@object-ui/fields` exports no "is this type masked" predicate.
  - `summaryChipRenderers.ts` and `summaryChip.badgeFitCensus-8464` call the four "value-independent faces". For the object value that census measures, the faces and the `fit` verdicts are unchanged. Owner: none.
- **H3, `vector` / `grid` populated face:** kept byte-identical, as instructed. For the record, the `VectorField` widget already draws a preview plus a dimension count for a stored embedding, so a cell could reuse that. That is a separate question.
- **Cross-band:** a `password` holding `['']` now draws "No value" in the cell while `hasCellValue` calls it filled. `text` has had exactly this behaviour all along, and this change inherits it deliberately so the string class answers one way.
